product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Suspended Wire Back-to-Back Ceiling Mount for Portrait Displays Window Shopping Fits 43-65TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Suspended Wire Back-to-Back Ceiling Mount for Portrait Displays Window Shopping, Fits 43"–65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Suspended Wire Back-to-Back Ceiling Mount for Window Shopping is designed for dual-sided, high-visibility signage where content must be viewed from both sides of a storefront or window. Using a suspended wire ceiling system, this mount supports two portrait-oriented displays mounted back to back, creating a clean, floating presentation ideal for retail windows, malls, and showrooms. It supports displays from 43" to 65" per screen while maintaining a minimal visual footprint and commercial-grade reliability.Supports two portrait-oriented displays mounted back to back for dual-direction viewingFits 43" to 65" TVs with a maximum load capacity of 55 lb (25 kg) per screenCompatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mmCeiling-suspended wire design requires no floor or wall attachmentIdeal for retail storefront windows, mall kiosks, and showroom signageMinimizes structural bulk while preserving sightlines to merchandise and interiorsHigh-strength steel suspension wires create a modern architectural floating appearanceDesigned for indoor commercial use; professional installation recommended BACK-TO-BACK DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONSupports two flat-panel displays mounted back to back, allowing content to be visible from inside and outside a storefront or from opposite directions in open retail environments. OPTIMIZED FOR WINDOW SHOPPING APPLICATIONSThe suspended wire design minimizes structural bulk, keeping the viewer's focus on the content while preserving sightlines to merchandise and interiors behind the display. PORTRAIT ORIENTATION FOR VERTICAL SIGNAGEDesigned specifically for portrait mode displays, making it ideal for digital posters, promotions, menus, and advertising commonly used in window-facing signage. SUSPENDED WIRE CEILING MOUNT SYSTEMHigh-strength steel suspension wires support the dual display assembly from the ceiling, creating a modern, architectural floating appearance suitable for premium retail spaces. COMMERCIAL GRADE RELIABILITYEngineered for professional AV installations with commercial-grade components.
